title: Assumption (batch 5): Poincare duality, AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.isIso_poincareMap
statement: Cited assumption of batch 5: upstream master WeilConjectures/PoincareDuality/Poincare.lean (d838516ef, #1448), declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.isIso_poincareMap, together with the other declarations of that file (uncurry_poincareMap, boundedConstructible_tateTwistDerived). Statement, as in [nt-target-poincare-isiso]: Let l be a prime and k a field of characteristic p>0 with p != l. Let X, S be separated schemes of finite type over Spec k (objects of Over (Spec k)) and p:X->S a morphism over k whose underlying morphism of schemes is smooth of pure relative dimension d (d in N). Write Qlb for the condensed ring Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l and D^b_c(T)[[Qlb]] for the bounded constructible derived category of Qlb-module objects on the pro-etale site of T, a monoidal closed full subcategory of the ambient derived category (isMonoidal_boundedConstructible, isMonoidalClosed_boundedConstructible), with unit Qlb_T and internal hom RHom. On it Lp^* -| Rp_* (boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction) and Rp_! -| Rp^! (boundedConstructibleUpperShriekAdjunction, Rp^! = boundedConstructibleUpperShriek built from a Nagata compactification), and PF^!: Rp_! K (x) B -> Rp_!(K (x) Lp^* B) is the derived exceptional projection morphism (boundedConstructibleExceptionalProjection). Qlb_X(d)[2d] = boundedConstructibleTateTwist l X d (2d) is the shift by 2d of the Tate twist tateTwistDerived X l d [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], bounded constructible by [nt-target-poincare-tate-bc], and pur_p: Rp^! Qlb_S ~= Qlb_X(d)[2d] (boundedConstructibleSmoothPurityIso) is the preimage under the fully faithful inclusion D^b_c -> D of the chosen smooth purity isomorphism smoothPurityIso l p d [nt-target-smooth-purity-qbar]. The Poincare duality morphism PD_p: Rp_* Qlb_X(d)[2d] -> RHom(Rp_! Qlb_X, Qlb_S) (poincareMap) is the composite of Rp_*(pur_p^{-1}), Rp_* of the identification Rp^! Qlb_S -> RHom(Qlb_X, Rp^! Qlb_S) (transpose of the left unitor) and the Verdier exchange morphism Phi_{p,K,L}: Rp_* RHom(K, Rp^! L) -> RHom(Rp_! K, L) at K=Qlb_X, L=Qlb_S, where Phi is the transpose of the pairing Rp_! K (x) Rp_* RHom(K,Rp^! L) -> Rp_!(K (x) Lp^* Rp_* RHom(K,Rp^! L)) -> Rp_!(K (x) RHom(K,Rp^! L)) -> Rp_! Rp^! L -> L (PF^!, the counit of Lp^* -| Rp_*, evaluation, the counit of Rp_! -| Rp^!). The trace Tr_p: Rp_! Qlb_X(d)[2d] -> Qlb_S (trace) is Rp_!(pur_p^{-1}) followed by the counit of Rp_! -| Rp^!, and the compact-support cup product cup_c: Rp_! Qlb_X (x) Rp_* Qlb_X(d)[2d] -> Rp_! Qlb_X(d)[2d] (cupProduct) is PF^!, Rp_!(Qlb_X (x) counit of Lp^* -| Rp_*) and the left unitor. Then PD_p is an isomorphism in D^b_c(S)[[Qlb]] (Poincare duality). Upstream deduces it from isIso_verdierExchange of WeilConjectures.PoincareDuality.Verdier (Verdier duality: Phi_{p,K,L} is an isomorphism for all bounded constructible K, L, from the derived projection formula isIso_boundedConstructibleExceptionalProjection_app_app by the Yoneda argument Verdier.isIso_exchange_of_isIso), since the other two factors of PD_p are isomorphisms. The upstream statement does not use the smoothness instance (omitted), but PD_p is built from pur_p, whose definition needs it. Scope (what this assumption does not give, as stated in the upstream file): the perfect pairing H^i_c(X,Qlb) x H^{2d-i}(X,Qlb(d)) -> Qlb on cohomology groups over S = Spec kbar (which needs the perfectness of Rp_! Qlb_X), Frobenius equivariance, and the compatibilities with base change, compactification and composition.
